comparison.objective: Sort conductors using a two-pad series tester; candidate fractures and retrieves HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Placing conductors across test contacts, reading results, and sorting versus coaxial tool insertion, hammer impact, and small-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Conductors sorted according to tester response; no specs, class definitions, or contact thresholds provided. Candidate requires four safe fractures and complete tang containment.
comparison.reason: Tests electrical-property probing and classification, not controlled material separation.
